A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 35-page versions of FAST-DIPS, including Appendix A.1–A.9 and supplementary figures. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to pages 1 and 3.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction accuracy and runtime experiments on FFHQ and ImageNet in Section 3, plus appendix ablations, robustness tests, JPEG restoration and high-resolution results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 3 and the appendices, including Table 1 and the supplementary experimental tables and figures.

M1.justification: The hard-constrained ADMM correction, analytic step sizes, re-annealing and pixel/latent hybrid procedure are unchanged in Section 2 and Algorithms 1–2. Figure 2 changes only mathematical typography.

E1.justification: Both retain the same eight FFHQ/ImageNet inverse problems and the appendix coverage of Poisson noise, JPEG restoration and 512×512 FFHQ deblurring.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the reported comparisons: DAPS, SITCOM, C-ΠGDM, HRDIS, Latent-DAPS, PSLD and ReSample, with the same task-specific participation. The QDP ablation control is also retained.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendices A.4–A.8 retain the same datasets and indices, sample counts, pretrained models, noise settings, metrics, computational budgets and timing procedures.

E4.justification: Projection and step-size ablations, iteration-budget studies, hyperparameter sensitivity, hybrid-switch analysis, Poisson-noise robustness and qualitative trajectories are identical in both versions.

E5.justification: Both retain seed 42, the best-of-four phase-retrieval protocol and the same averaging practices. No repeated-run information, uncertainty estimates or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative reconstruction examples are retained. For example, Table 1 reports identical FFHQ pixel Gaussian-deblurring results: 29.406 PSNR, 0.836 SSIM, 0.247 LPIPS and 2.612 seconds. Figure 1 changes formatting without changing scores or images.

T1.justification: The assumptions, propositions, step-size derivations, KKT arguments and re-annealing KL bound remain unchanged, including Appendix A.3 proofs. Figure 2's brace and operator-font adjustments do not change mathematical meaning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: an adjoint-free feasibility solver, local theoretical guarantees, latent/hybrid execution and competitive reconstruction quality with up to 19.5× speedup.

C2.justification: The explanations of FD versus JVP behavior, hybrid scheduling and noise robustness are unchanged. Appendix A.9 retains the same dependence on differentiable forward operators and proposed future extensions.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, autodiff implementation details, validation indices, hardware, baseline access information and the code/data link are identical in Section 5 and Appendices A.5–A.7.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to PnP-ADMM, diffusion posterior sampling, decoupled methods and fast samplers are unchanged. The reference list is identical.

P1.justification: Surface text changes include spacing in Figure 1's 'OURS (Pixel)' label and the updated arXiv version/date stamp. The prose, section order and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1(b) receives small label and metric-overlay formatting adjustments; Figure 2 receives minor equation-font and projection-brace adjustments. Captions, reconstruction images, tables and the remaining page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 makes small typographic adjustments to Figures 1–2 while retaining the same scientific content, results, proofs, reproducibility information and complete appendix. These cosmetic changes do not establish a meaningful overall gain or loss in clarity or evidential support.
